| ga_01 | 1.4 (+10.5) | narrator | 在天上，有一座发光的城。那里住着上帝的天使。其中有一位大天使，名字叫加百列。 | High above, there is a city full of light, where God's angels live. One of them is a great archangel. His name is Gabriel. | hushed wonder, like opening a treasure box; slow, a smile on the name 加百列 / 'Gabriel' |
